get.summary: Opens the event stream; the first event is `hello` with the stream id. Answers 204 (which browsers do not retry) while live updates are off. The response is never compressed or cached and asks proxies not to buffer it (M10 plan section 7).
get.description:
**Permission:** Any signed-in user.

Events (`event:` line, then a `data:` line with JSON):

| Event | Data |
| --- | --- |
| `hello` | `LiveHelloDto` |
| `item-changed` | `LiveItemsDto` |
| `item-removed` | `LiveItemsDto` |
| `links-changed` | `LiveLinksDto` |
| `board-changed` | `LiveProjectDto` |
| `access-changed` | `LiveProjectDto` |
| `notification` | `{}` |
| `presence` | `LivePresenceDto` |
| `project-resync` | `LiveProjectDto` |
| `resync` | `{}` |
| `disabled` | `{}` |

A comment line `: heartbeat` keeps the connection open; the first message also sets `retry: 5000`.

info.title: Kloister API
info.description: REST API of Kloister under `/api/v1`, JSON unless a route says otherwise. Sign in with `POST /api/v1/auth/login`; the session travels in the `sid` cookie. Every request that is not GET, HEAD or OPTIONS needs the header `x-requested-with: kloister`. Authorization is enforced by the API; items the caller may not see answer 404. Errors share the `ApiError` shape. The readable reference is docs/technical/API.md.

csrf.name: x-requested-with
csrf.description: Must be `kloister` on every request that is not GET, HEAD or OPTIONS, sign-in included.

email.description: Not checked as an email here: any mismatch is just a failed login.

password.description: No minimum on login, so old or temporary passwords still work.

currentPassword.description: The password the user currently has.

newPassword.description: At least 12 characters; no composition rules (SPEC §5).

email.description: Login email. TLDs are optional because internal mail domains often lack one.

mode.description: Light, dark or the operating system's choice.

pmUserIds.description: The Project Managers: one or more distinct users.

membersCanAssignOthers.description: Lets Members assign items to others.

statusToBucket.description: Replaces the status → bucket map (SPEC §4.2); `{}` clears it.

labelStyle.description: Label style for the whole project (SPEC §4, §6).

autoMoveDependents.description: Timeline date changes move dependent items without asking (SPEC §6.4).

useInstanceHolidays.description: The timeline uses the instance-wide holidays (M9.1).

planLeadsOnly.description: Only PMs and Leads change the plan of existing items (M9.2).

afterId.description: Row to place this one after; omit or null for the first place.

adoIterationPath.description: New override, or null to clear.

moveUnfinishedTo.description: Open sprint for unfinished items, null for the backlog, omitted to leave them.

startSecondHalf.description: Starts in the 2nd half of the start date (M9).

dueFirstHalf.description: Finishes after the 1st half of the due date (M9).

dueTime.description: Due time `HH:MM` on the due date.

startSecondHalf.description: Starts in the 2nd half of the start date (M9).

dueFirstHalf.description: Finishes after the 1st half of the due date (M9).

dueTime.description: New due time `HH:MM`, or null; needs a due date.

bucketId.description: Target bucket; omitted keeps the bucket, null takes an Epic/Feature off the board.

afterId.description: Item to place the card after; omitted or null for the top.

blockingItemId.description: The item that blocks this one.

assigneeIds.description: Optional assignees, checked by ordinary creation permissions.

bucketId.description: Explicit destination bucket, including off-board for compatible types.

teamId.description: Explicit optional team; ordinary creation rules apply.

parentId.description: Optional readable parent compatible with the copied type.

keepDates.description: Keep both calendar dates only when requested.

keepSprint.description: Keep the source's open sprint only when requested.

attachments.description: Copy non-inline attachments only when requested.

through.description: The newest instance change the caller saw (ISO timestamp); default now.

pinTo.description: An exact pin to restore (Undo), or null for none.

mode.description: Preview, apply, or apply only the changes.

expect.description: Versions the caller saw, by item id.

body.description: New HTML; sanitized by the server.

absoluteTimeoutMinutes.description: Absolute timeout in minutes; at least the idle timeout (checked by the service).

lockoutThreshold.description: Failed sign-ins in a row before a lockout.

projectQuotaMb.description: Per-project space in MB; at least the file size limit (checked by the service).

retentionDays.description: Days daily log files are kept.

enabled.description: Whether live updates and presence are on.

appName.description: App name, shown in the shell and the page title. Control and format characters are refused.

font.description: The UI font; `UPLOADED` needs an uploaded regular file (checked by the service).

organization.description: Organization/collection identity, never a fetch target.

profile.description: Nested mappings receive additional semantic validation in the service.

requireDetailedReview.description: Whether every transfer must use Detailed review.

csv.description: UTF-8 file text, also checked by byte length.

assignees.description: Single outgoing assignee for each local item.

previewDigest.description: Digest from preview, required by prepare.

csv.description: UTF-8 file text, also checked by byte length.

selectedRows.description: Null explicitly selects every uploaded row.

manualLinks.description: Remote IDs mapped to known local pending items.

createLabels.description: Explicit label creation list, semantically validated before use.

duplicateRiskAcknowledged.description: Acknowledges that the operator may already have created remote duplicates.

projectId.description: Project id or key, or null to follow none.

action.description: What the tab does on it.

field.description: Field being edited; only known field keys, so no free text travels.

message.description: Readable summary, safe to show to users.

details.description: Optional detail; for `VALIDATION_FAILED` a list of `{ field, messages }` per invalid field.

UserDto.description: A user as the API returns it. The password hash and lockout counters are never exposed.

mustChangePassword.description: True until the user replaces an admin-issued temporary password.

lastLoginAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last successful login, or null.

SystemRole.description: System-wide roles (SPEC §3.1). Everything else is decided per project.

AuditEntryDto.description: An audit log entry as returned by `GET /admin/audit`.

actorId.description: Acting user id, or null for anonymous/CLI actions.

actorEmail.description: Acting user's email at read time, or null.

actorName.description: Acting user's display name at read time, or null (M8.5).

projectKey.description: Project key at read time; null for personal spaces or no project.

projectName.description: Project name at read time, or null.

entityLabel.description: The entity by name at read time: item key, user or member name, project key, bucket/label/sprint/team name; null when deleted or not named.

entityId.description: Id of the affected entity, if any.

projectId.description: Project the action belongs to, if any.

temporaryPassword.description: Random password the user must change at next login.

MyThemeDto.description: Response of `GET /me/theme`: the caller's own theme, or null when they use the admin default.

theme.description: The caller's theme, or null for "use default".

ThemeDto.description: A theme: mode plus primary and accent colour (SPEC §6). The web app derives the soft, line and ink variants of both colours and adjusts them until text on them reaches WCAG AA contrast (docs/DESIGN.md §2.1); the stored colours stay as chosen.

mode.description: Light, dark, or the operating system's choice.

ThemeMode.description: Light or dark mode (SPEC §6). `SYSTEM` follows the operating system's preference.

ProjectDto.description: A project as the API returns it, from the caller's point of view.

key.description: Unique key, or null for a personal space.

ownerId.description: Personal owner; null for an ordinary project.

archivedAt.description: ISO timestamp when archived, or null. Archived projects are read-only.

myRole.description: The caller's role, or null when an admin views a project they are not a member of.

myTeams.description: The caller's teams in this project and their role in each.

myPermissions.description: What the caller may do here; the UI uses this only to hide controls.

summary.description: Counts for the Projects list (M8.5), limited to what the caller can see; null where the caller is not a member (an admin's "All projects" rows), absent outside the list.

ProjectSettings.description: Project settings stored in `Project.settings` (SPEC §4). M8 adds the ADO export settings.

membersCanAssignOthers.description: Lets Members assign items to others (SPEC §3.2; default off).

statusToBucket.description: Status → bucket moves; only buckets of the project, empty by default.

labelStyle.description: How labels are drawn on cards and in the drawer (SPEC §4, §6; set by PMs).

autoMoveDependents.description: Timeline date changes move dependent items without asking (SPEC §6.4, M9). Off when missing, so existing projects keep the confirmation; new projects start with it on.

useInstanceHolidays.description: The project's timeline uses the instance-wide holidays (M9.1; default on).

holidaysReviewedAt.description: When the project's PMs or Leads last reviewed instance holiday changes, or null (M9.1).

planLeadsOnly.description: Only PMs, Leads and the item's team Leads change an existing item's plan: title, type, parent, sprint, dates, half days, pin and dependencies (M9.2; default on, also for projects from before it). Members still set them when creating.

LabelStyle.description: Label styles a PM can choose per project (SPEC §4, docs/DESIGN.md §4.2): full-colour pills, soft tinted pills, or tinted pills plus a colour bar across the top of the card.

Visibility.description: Which items a Member or Viewer sees (SPEC §3.3). PMs and Leads always see everything, whatever is stored for them.

TeamRole.description: Role inside an optional project team (SPEC §3.5).

ProjectPermission.description: Permission names, one per row of the SPEC §3.2 table. Rows with a condition ("own/assigned only", "own created, no children") are split into an unconditional and an `_OWN` permission; the API checks the condition against the item.

ProjectSummaryDto.description: What the caller can see of a project's work, for the Projects list.

open.description: Visible items that are not Done.

overdue.description: Visible open items past their due date, or due time today (server time).

lastActivityAt.description: ISO time of the newest recorded change to a visible item, or null.

ProjectMemberDto.description: A project member as returned by `GET /projects/:id/members`.

isActive.description: False when the account is deactivated.

visibility.description: Stored visibility scope (ignored for PM and Lead).

ProjectRole.description: Per-project roles (SPEC §3.2). System admins have no project role unless they are also added as members.

MemberCandidateDto.description: A user that can be added to a project, from `GET /projects/:id/member-candidates`.

TeamMemberDto.description: A team member as returned inside TeamDto.

isActive.description: False when the account is deactivated.

onEnterStatus.description: Status set by the rule, or null for `NONE`.

BucketRule.description: What moving a card into a bucket does to its status (SPEC §4.2).

adoIterationPath.description: ADO iteration path override, or null.

SprintState.description: Sprint lifecycle. A project has at most one `ACTIVE` sprint.

movedItems.description: How many unfinished items were moved.

WorkItemDto.description: A work item as returned by list endpoints.

ancestors.description: Ancestors from the root down to the parent, as read-only titles.

bucketId.description: Bucket id; null only for Epics and Features off the board.

startSecondHalf.description: The item starts in the 2nd half of its start date (timeline, M9).

dueFirstHalf.description: The item finishes after the 1st half of its due date (timeline, M9).

dueTime.description: Optional due time `HH:MM` on the due date, or null (M8.5).

startNoEarlierThan.description: "Start no earlier than" pin set on the timeline, or null (M9).

childCount.description: Number of child items (in any scope).

completedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the status became DONE, or null.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last change.

can.description: What the caller may do with this item.

ItemRefDto.description: A reference to an item: enough to show it as a read-only title. Ancestors outside a restricted visibility scope are returned only in this form (SPEC §3.3).

ItemStatus.description: Work item status; independent of the bucket (SPEC §4.2).

ItemCapabilitiesDto.description: What the caller may do with an item; the UI uses this only to hide controls.

plan.description: Change the title, type, parent, sprint, dates, half days, pin and dependencies (M9.2): `edit` unless the project keeps the plan to PMs and Leads.

move.description: Move the card between and within buckets.

deleteCascade.description: Delete the item with all its descendants.

WorkItemDetailDto.description: A work item with its checklist and dependencies, from `GET …/items/:item`.

blockedBy.description: Visible items this one is blocked by.

ancestors.description: Ancestors from the root down to the parent, as read-only titles.

bucketId.description: Bucket id; null only for Epics and Features off the board.

startSecondHalf.description: The item starts in the 2nd half of its start date (timeline, M9).

dueFirstHalf.description: The item finishes after the 1st half of its due date (timeline, M9).

dueTime.description: Optional due time `HH:MM` on the due date, or null (M8.5).

startNoEarlierThan.description: "Start no earlier than" pin set on the timeline, or null (M9).

childCount.description: Number of child items (in any scope).

completedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the status became DONE, or null.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last change.

can.description: What the caller may do with this item.

UserWorkDto.description: Answer of `GET /users/:userId/work`: the person and one page of the items assigned to them that the caller can see.

items.description: Items on this page, due date first (undated last).

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null on the last page.

WorkPersonDto.description: The person whose work is listed.

WorkSummaryDto.description: One item in a person's "all their work" list (SPEC §6): enough to show it in a cross-project list and to open it in its project.

projectKey.description: Project key, for the item's link (`/p/:key/items/:number`).

personal.description: True only for the caller's own personal tasks.

bucket.description: Bucket metadata belongs to this project, never a cross-project column.

labels.description: Readable labels belonging to this item.

canEdit.description: Whether the viewer can edit the status.

actor.description: Who caused it; null for due-date notifications or removed accounts.

readAt.description: ISO timestamp when read, or null while unread.

NotificationType.description: In-app notification types (SPEC §6). Due-date notifications come from the daily check at 09:00 server time.

NotificationItemDto.description: The item a notification is about, as the recipient sees it now.

count.description: Unread notifications the caller can still open.

holidays.description: The project's calendar: its own holidays plus, when used, the instance ones.

useInstanceHolidays.description: The project uses the instance holidays.

instanceChanges.description: Instance holidays added or removed since the project's PMs and Leads last reviewed them (empty when the project does not use them).

scope.description: An instance-wide holiday from the admin settings, or one of the project.

deletedAt.description: ISO timestamp of removal, or null; only removed instance holidays are listed, as changes.

edges.description: "Blocked by" links whose both ends the caller can see.

PlanEdge.description: A "blocked by" link between two items the caller can see.

items.description: The changed items after applying; empty for a preview.

rescheduleId.description: Shared by the audit entries of this reschedule; null for a preview.

requested.description: True for a change the caller asked for.

snapped.description: A requested start before the earliest allowed one was moved to it.

version.description: The item's version (`updatedAt`) before the change.

ScheduleDates.description: The scheduling fields of an item.

startSecondHalf.description: The item starts in the 2nd half of its start date.

dueFirstHalf.description: The item finishes after the 1st half of its due date.

HalfDay.description: One half of a calendar day.

RescheduleKeptDto.description: A visible dependent item that stays where it is.

KeptReason.description: Why a reached item was left where it is.

NoteDto.description: A note on a work item, from `GET …/items/:item/notes`.

body.description: Sanitized HTML. Mentions are `@Name`; images point at the item's own inline-image endpoint.

editedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last edit, or null if never edited.

can.description: What the caller may do with it.

AnnotationCapabilitiesDto.description: What the caller may do with a note or attachment; the UI only hides controls.

edit.description: Change the note (its author only). Always false for attachments.

delete.description: Delete it (its author, or a moderator: PMs, Leads and the item's team Leads).

AttachmentDto.description: A file attached to a work item, from `GET …/items/:item/attachments`.

name.description: The file name as uploaded (cleaned of path parts and control characters).

mimeType.description: Type detected from the content; `application/octet-stream` when unknown.

url.description: App-relative download URL (served as a download, never shown inline).

can.description: What the caller may do with it.

InlineImageDto.description: Answer to an inline image upload (`POST …/items/:item/images`).

url.description: App-relative URL to use as the `` source; see inlineImagePath.

name.description: The file name, for the image's alternative text.

idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Sessions idle longer than this end. Default 480 (8 hours).

absoluteTimeoutMinutes.description: Sessions end this long after sign-in. Default 10080 (7 days).

lockoutThreshold.description: Failed sign-ins in a row that lock an account. Default 5.

lockoutMinutes.description: How long a locked account stays locked. Default 15.

maxFileSizeMb.description: Largest file accepted, in MB. Default 25.

projectQuotaMb.description: Space per project for attachments and inline images, in MB. Default 2048.

personalQuotaMb.description: Per-user personal attachment quota in MB; default 1024.

app.description: The app's folder (`/app/<app_name>`), everything below it included.

disk.description: The file system holding the app's folder, or null when unknown.

bytes.description: Total size of its files, in bytes.

retentionDays.description: Daily log files older than this many days are deleted. Default 30.

enabled.description: Whether streams are accepted; default true.

PublicBrandingDto.description: What every visitor needs to draw the app, from the public `GET /branding`: the login page shows it before anyone signs in, so it holds nothing beyond the name, the logo and font locations and the default theme.

appName.description: App name for the shell and the page title.

logoUrl.description: App-relative URL of the logo (changes with each upload), or null.

font.description: The UI font in use. `UPLOADED` only when the uploaded regular file exists; otherwise the chosen preset, or Figtree.

fontFiles.description: App-relative URLs of the uploaded font files, when `font` is `UPLOADED`.

UiFont.description: The UI font (SPEC §6, docs/DESIGN.md §6): a bundled or installed preset, or the font file an admin uploaded. One font for everyone.

appName.description: App name; the default when never set.

font.description: The chosen font (`UPLOADED` may be chosen only with a regular file).

BrandingFileDto.description: A stored branding file, as admins see it.

name.description: Name of the file as uploaded.

running.description: True while a backup is running.

nextRunAt.description: ISO timestamp of the next scheduled run, or null when disabled.

files.description: Backup files on the server, newest first.

folder.description: The backups folder on the server.

enabled.description: Whether the daily backup runs. Default true.

time.description: Server-local time of the daily backup, `HH:MM`. Default `02:00`.

retentionDays.description: Backups older than this many days are deleted after a successful backup. Default 14.

BackupRunDto.description: One finished backup, from the audit log.

file.description: Backup file name, when it succeeded.

sizeBytes.description: Backup size in bytes, when it succeeded.

error.description: Why it failed, when it failed.

pruned.description: Old backups deleted afterwards under the retention setting.

BackupFileDto.description: A backup file in the backups folder.

modifiedAt.description: ISO timestamp of its last change.

status.description: Always `'ok'` when the process is able to answer requests.

AdoDestinationDto.description: Read-only profile details available to PMs and project Leads.

requireDetailedReview.description: Set by a project PM: every transfer in this project must use Detailed review.

organization.description: Organization/collection identity, stored canonically, never fetched.

revision.description: Optimistic config revision; zero for first setup.

AdoProfile.description: Per-project reviewed process and field contract; no credentials.

process.description: Template used for the explicit flattening policy.

types.description: Forward types; null explicitly omits a type.

reverseTypes.description: Unambiguous reverse choices for incoming new types.

states.description: Forward states indexed by local type, then local status. Null omits State.

incomingStates.description: Remote type/state keys use a newline separator.

fields.description: Enabled optional field headers; dates default disabled.

dateTypes.description: Date capability is disabled for every type until explicitly confirmed.

identities.description: Local member IDs to remote identity strings.

incomingIdentities.description: Incoming aliases to an existing member ID or explicit unassigned.

tags.description: Remote tags to existing label IDs or explicit omission.

iterations.description: Iteration paths to existing sprint IDs or explicit no sprint.

iterationRoot.description: Remote path used when no sprint override is set.

area.description: Default outgoing area, metadata only on import.

constants.description: Required extra columns; reserved columns cannot be overridden.

dateOrder.description: Day/month order of slash dates in ADO exports, which follow the exporting user's locale. Optional: unambiguous dates and ISO dates never need it.

AdoProcess.description: Supported templates; a preset always requires destination review.

AdoSampleResult.description: What a sample ADO export contains, used to suggest mappings; nothing is stored.

process.description: Process suggested by the work item types present, if recognizable.

tags.description: Distinct tags.

identities.description: Distinct identities as exported, with the email when present.

dateOrder.description: Day/month order when the dates prove it, otherwise null.

batchId.description: Persisted batch identity, null for an unprepared outbound preview.

errors.description: Errors must be resolved in a new preview before apply/prepare.

summary.description: Counts confirmed before apply or prepare.

AdoPreviewRow.description: One reviewed row, without raw CSV or hidden-project information.

index.description: Zero-based CSV row or outgoing item order.

remoteId.description: Positive remote ID, never converted to a JavaScript number.

changes.description: Fields this row actually sends to ADO or applies here.

AdoDifference.description: Visible three-way field comparison; rendered as text, never trusted HTML.

baselineLocal.description: Last confirmed local value or null.

baselineRemote.description: Last confirmed remote value or null.

conflict.description: Both sides changed since confirmation, or no confirmed baseline exists.

choice.description: Current resolution, explicit or chosen by Quick review.

auto.description: True when Quick review chose this because only one side changed.

newItem.description: True for a row that becomes a new Kloister item: there is no Kloister value or last sync to compare, so the only choices are to take or leave out ADO's value.

AdoField.description: Transferable scalar fields. Missing columns preserve local values.

kinds.description: Rows per kind (create, update, link, unchanged, ...).

fields.description: Fields that will change, with how many rows each.

conflicts.description: Fields changed on both sides that still need a choice.

enabled.description: False when an admin switched live updates off.

LiveItemDto.description: One changed or removed item, with who changed it.

actorId.description: Who made the change; null for the system (scheduled jobs).

deleted.description: On `item-removed`: true when deleted, false when it left the viewer's scope.

ids.description: Items at either end of the changed links; all visible to the viewer.

LivePresenceDtoResponse.description: Data of `presence`: everyone else on the project, as the viewer may see them.

people.description: One entry per person, their most recent action.

PresenceEntryDto.description: One person on the subscribed project.

itemId.description: The item they have open, or null when only on the project's pages.

action.description: What they are doing on that item; null without an item.

field.description: The field they are editing, with `editing` only.

BadRequest.description: `VALIDATION_FAILED`: a parameter or body field is invalid; `details` lists `{ field, messages }` per field. A password change with a wrong current password answers `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`.

Unauthenticated.description: `UNAUTHENTICATED`: no valid session cookie. Sign-in with a wrong email or password answers `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`.

Forbidden.description: `FORBIDDEN` (the role or a rule does not allow it), `PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED` (the temporary password must be changed first) or `CSRF_HEADER_MISSING` (a write without the header).

NotFound.description: `NOT_FOUND`: it does not exist, or the caller may not know it exists (non-members, items outside the visibility scope).

Conflict.description: `CONFLICT` or a specific code (`PROJECT_ARCHIVED`, `HAS_CHILDREN`, `BUCKET_NOT_EMPTY`, `LAST_ADMIN`, `LAST_PM`, `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`, `BACKUP_RUNNING`): the change clashes with the current state.

TooLarge.description: `FILE_TOO_LARGE`: the upload exceeds the size limit. A body above the request limit of the route also answers 413.

UnsupportedType.description: `UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE`: the file content is not an accepted type.

RateLimited.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: too many sign-in attempts; see the `Retry-After` header.
